dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O' shaped structures in the central-lateral region exhibit irregular, crenulated perimeter geometries. These rings show a sharp gradient transition from the dark-gray background pelt to a high-intensity white/light-gray border, characterized by stippled edge patterns.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, high-intensity white pixel clusters is visible interspersed between the macro-annuli and concentrated along the dorsal ridge. These clusters are asymmetrical and lack internal luminance gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most distinct centrally-located annuli form a scalene triangle. Connecting these centroids to the prominent high-intensity blobs located anteriorly creates a series of irregular polygonal geometric relationships.
